description:
FreeCAD is open with a T8 Housing Bracket loaded. Your goal is to design a rectangular mold cavity block for this part.

1. Create a rectangular Box (mold stock) that fully encloses the bracket with a margin of at least 10mm on all sides (X, Y, and Z).
2. Center the Box relative to the bracket so the bracket is in the middle of the mold.
3. Perform a Boolean Cut operation to subtract the bracket from the box (creating the cavity).
4. Set the transparency of the resulting mold object to 50% so the internal cavity is visible.
5. Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/mold_cavity.FCStd'.
